name: plotly
title: Plotly figure
description: Shows a Plotly figure saved as JSON, such as Python's fig.write_json(), with hover.

figure.description: The figure: an object with data and, optionally, layout.

scale.description: The poster's pixels per CSS pixel, above 0 and at most 8.

template.description: paper styles the figure with the paper's theme in both colour modes; figure keeps the figure's own template.
